sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, ON Fly is a puzzle game that requires players to navigate through a series of increasingly challenging levels to collect gems. The game's mechanics are simple yet addictive, making it easy to pick up but difficult to put down. Players use their mouse, keyboard, or touch controls to control their character, navigating through levels and avoiding obstacles to collect gems.

The game's core gameplay mechanic is based on timing and strategy. Players must time their movements perfectly to avoid obstacles and collect gems. As players progress through levels, the obstacles become increasingly difficult to navigate, requiring players to think carefully and react quickly to succeed.

One of the standout features of ON Fly's core gameplay mechanics is its focus on momentum and velocity. Players must manage their character's speed and momentum to navigate through levels and collect gems. This requires a delicate balance of speed and control, adding a layer of complexity and challenge to the game.

Overall, ON Fly's core gameplay mechanics are engaging, addictive, and challenging, making it a must-play for puzzle game fans.
